metadata.description: Dive into 99 engaging questions across five categories: Funny, Thoughtful, Interesting, Kind, and Random. Perfect for dinner tables, car rides, or any gathering, these prompts spark laughter, curiosity, and deep conversations. Ideal for all ages, they strengthen bonds and create lasting memories. Enjoy lively discussions and fun interactions with every play!
